brief.headline: Push to ₹0.65–0.80/pc on the 28 mm cap (market says there's room at volume) and bring in Manjushree as a qualified second source to lock leverage.

priceAsk.summary: Ask for ₹0.65–0.80/pc on the 28 mm induction-wad PP cap at higher volumes
priceAsk.basis: The market ask is ₹0.55–1.20/pc, typical ₹0.85–0.95/pc, with the verdict saying MARKET-FAIR but modest headroom to ₹0.65–0.80 at higher volume or looser spec — we're buying ₹67.47 L a year, so we have the volume to hit that lower band.

paymentTermAsk.summary: Keep the current 30 Days After Receipt — it already frees up ₹5.55 L for us and is not our worst term
paymentTermAsk.cashImpact: ₹5.55 L already freed up versus paying upfront; moving to 15 days earlier would cost us ₹2.77 L, so hold the line at 30 days

brief.financialLeverage: Empire publishes no financials, so we can't read their balance sheet or cash position. That means we lean on our own spend (₹67.47 L a year) and the market: five strong alternates are on hand, including Manjushree (₹2569.83 Cr revenue, health B 65/100), the country's largest rigid-plastic converter and a pharma bottles/caps specialist. With no visibility into Empire's books, our leverage comes from having credible backup options and the market verdict that there's room to move down at volume. Push firmly but line up a second source in parallel — if Empire won't move or falters, we switch without drama.

evidence.point: Market research shows the 28 mm PP cap typically sells at ₹0.85–0.95/pc, with room to ₹0.65–0.80 at higher volume
evidence.figure: askBand ₹0.55–1.20/pc, typical ₹0.85–0.95/pc, verdict MARKET-FAIR; modest headroom to ₹0.65–0.80 at higher volume / looser spec

alternates.why: Listed rigid-plastic leader (pails, containers, pharma); strong and profitable — a robust alternate for bottles and closures

risks: Empire publishes no financials — we're flying blind on their stability, so watch for any service hiccups (late delivery, quality slips) that might signal trouble.
If Empire digs in on price, we have no borrowing-cost or margin data to justify a faster-payment swap — the ask stands on market research and volume alone, so be ready to walk to Manjushree.
The market ask shows a wide band (₹0.55–1.20/pc) — if Empire claims our spec or volume doesn't qualify for the lower ₹0.65–0.80 range, ask for the spec change or MOQ needed to get there, in writing.

We have several market backup leads (Reliance, Srichakra, Dalmia, Ganesha, Chemco) but none are qualified yet — treat them as research only; don't promise the team a switch until we've audited and priced at least one.
brief.suggestedOpeningLine: We'd like to move our 28 mm cap price down to ₹0.65–0.80 per piece at our current volume — the market shows there's room there, and we're qualifying Manjushree as a second source to make sure we have the capacity and the price we need.
